lines.text: Many learners say: He is enough old to drive.
Better: He is old enough to drive.
Old enough! He is old enough to drive.

data.wrong: He is enough old to drive.
data.right: He is old enough to drive.

native.tip: 中文说“够大了”，“够”在前面，所以容易说 enough old。英语的 enough 要放在 old 后面。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “He is enough old to drive.”😅 中文的“够”放在前面，英语的 enough 要放在 old 后面：“He is old enough to drive.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“He is old enough to drive.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese puts 够 first, but English puts enough after the word.
en.caption: Do you say “He is enough old to drive.” 😅 English puts enough after old: “He is old enough to drive.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
